tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Finds regular files in the local workspace using a deterministic workspace-relative glob pattern.

pattern.description: Workspace-relative glob pattern; ** matches complete path segments

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Searches UTF-8 text files in the local workspace using deterministic line-oriented RE2 semantics.

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Reads a UTF-8 text file from the local workspace with stable 1-based line numbers.

file_path.description: The absolute or workspace-relative path to the file to read

offset.description: The 1-based line number to start reading from

limit.description: The maximum number of lines to read
